newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti declines comment on PC sale story.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti declines comment on PC sale story.

text.p: Italy's information technology group Olivetti declined to comment on an article in weekly magazine Panorama that U.S. group Centenary had signed a letter of intent to buy Olivetti's ailing personal computer company.
"We do not comment on any negotiations on the PC business. When the sale is completed we will say so," said an Olivetti spokesman from the group headquarter in Ivrea, near Turin.
Olivetti had planned to sell its loss-making PC business by the end of this year, but on Wednesday group chief executive Roberto Colaninno said there may be a delay in the sell-off.
Centenary specialises in buying up struggling companies and restructuring them.
